about.titleHtml:
A fresh approach to
property valuation
in the Kingdom.
about.lead: Asia Pacific Property Appraisal Co., Ltd. was founded in 2021 on a simple conviction: that a valuation is only as good as the standard behind it, and the data beneath it.
about.bodyHtml: We apply the International Valuation Standard (IVS) and the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) standard to every engagement — benchmarks that many firms in the region have not yet been able to implement. That discipline is what makes an APP report hold up: in a bank's credit committee, in an auditor's file, and in a cross-border transaction.
about.p1.title: The deepest local database
about.p1.desc: An extensive Cambodian real estate database built over decades of transactions — the evidence base that turns an opinion into a defensible figure.
about.p2.title: Ethics as the first test
about.p2.desc: Our values and ethics have always been the main determinant of any action we take. Independence isn't a policy page — it's the reason our numbers are worth reading.
about.p3.title: Valuers trained to standard
about.p3.desc: Every valuer is trained in IVS and RICS methodology. The expertise of our appraisers is the main factor in our success — so we invest there first.
about.p4.title: Trusted by the financial sector
about.p4.desc: Deep working relationships with Cambodia's banks, financial institutions and domestic SMEs — the clients whose decisions depend on getting the number right.
about.quote: Human and financial capital complement each other. We keep working to realise our vision — continuously finding new and better ways to accurately value your property.
about.quoteAttrHtml: APP Appraisal — on our founding values
about.cta.title: Want the detail behind the approach?
about.cta.desc: Read how we scope an engagement, what evidence we rely on, and who signs the report.
standards.titleHtml: Trusted insights backed by the<br class="hidden lg:block"> highest global standards.
standards.sub: Every report we produce is meticulously prepared against international benchmarks — so your valuation is reliable, globally recognised, and defensible wherever it's read.
services.note: Whatever the asset class, the method is the same: evidence first, standard applied, conclusion you can defend.
network.p1Html: APP Appraisal is the Cambodia practice of the Twin Pillars valuation network — a group of affiliated firms operating across Asia from a head office in Singapore.
network.p2: For a client in Phnom Penh, that means a valuer who knows the street. For a client in Singapore, Bangkok or Ho Chi Minh City, it means Cambodian assets valued to the same standard as the rest of the portfolio — by people the network already trusts.
network.noteHtml: Mr. Sorn Seap, APP's Chairman, serves as Managing Director for Cambodia within the network.
leadership.sub: A valuation carries the signature of the person who prepared it. Ours are signed by practitioners with decades in Cambodia's property, banking and finance sectors.
leadership.cta.title: Talk to a valuer, not a call centre.
leadership.cta.desc: Every engagement is scoped directly with the team who will sign the report.
partners.sub: Some engagements need expertise that no single Cambodian practice holds in-house. These are the partners we work with when they do — named individuals at named firms, so you know exactly who is behind the number.
